ana: quick flag — phoenix11b-slim int4 onboarding shows a drop in exact-match on codegen tasks for >2048 tokens. short snippets fine.

infra-bot: eval/job/4971717171 finished: task=codegen-longctx, metric=exact_match, float=0.81, int4=0.59, delta=-0.22 :rotating_light:

kevin: any sign of tokenizer drift? often unicode normalization differences bite long snippets.

ana: tokenizer delta tiny (0.3%). I inspected model manifest: fan-provided meta includes "rotary":{"style":"per_head_scale","values":"hetero"} — runtime only reads single float.

sasha: per-head scaling + int4 rounding is classic amplifier. Did converter preserve rotary meta?

ana: converter run: ```bash
python tools/convert.py --src phoenix11b/ckpt --dst redwood/phoenix11b-slim-rlib --quant int4 --write-manifest
```
It wrote manifest but runtime ignored per-head array.

ren: quick smoke bisect plan: 1) float with our runtime + our tokenizer, 2) float with ckpt tokenizer, 3) int4 with runtime shim that reads per-head scales (apply at write vs read), 4) int4 with stable kernel warmup.

kevin: run 1/2 to isolate tokenizer first.

infra-bot: eval/job/4971717180 completed: float+our-tokenizer exact=0.806

infra-bot: eval/job/4971717185 completed: float+ckpt-tokenizer exact=0.811

ana: tokenizer not root cause. kicking off int4 variants.

infra-bot: eval/job/4971717190 completed: int4+shim(at-read) exact=0.642

infra-bot: eval/job/4971717200 completed: int4+shim(at-write) exact=0.689

infra-bot: eval/job/4971717210 completed: int4+shim(at-write)+warmup-stable(64) exact=0.715

kevin: interesting: rescaling on write improves more than at-read. suggests quant rounding accumulates in cache. warmup helps too.

sasha: action items: (A) runtime: add parsing for per-head rotary arrays and default to rescale-on-write when present (B) converter: if per-head meta present, surface warning and set manifest flag (C) infra: add warmup-stable option for onboarding int4 runs and expose in CI.

ana: i'll prototype a small patch to runtime: apply per-head scale before storing k/v to cache. patch snippet:```diff
--- a/runtime/kv_cache.cpp
+++ b/runtime/kv_cache.cpp
@@
- store_kv(layer, head, k, v);
+ auto ks = scale_kv_if_needed(head, k);
+ auto vs = scale_kv_if_needed(head, v);
+ store_kv(layer, head, ks, vs);
```

ren: also add an onboarding lint that fails (soft) when ckpt declares per-head rotary and runtime default!=manifest. prevents silent regressions.

kevin: agreed. if full eval recovers to >0.78 we can merge shim+converter warning.

infra-bot: job/4971717293 started: full-eval-int4-shim-write-warmup

ana: linking ticket RI-24680 with reproducible snippet, failing pairs, and tokenizer diffs. keeping this thread as canonical triage. :white_check_mark:
